title: Shrug It Off 2
description: A simple mod that makes armor toughness more usefull
body:
### Shrug it Off 2
#### A remake of the mod Shrug it Off for 1.12.2 [Original Mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/shrug-it-off)

### Features
This mod simply adds a chance for damage to be completly negated based on armor toughness and the incomming damage. Config options are soon to come.
